# Abdalrahman Valabji — Lead Software Developer

> Official bilingual portfolio of Abdalrahman Valabji (عبدالرحمن فلبجي), a Lead Software Developer based in Alexandria, Egypt. He has 13+ years of professional experience delivering mobile applications, web products, backend systems, technical migrations, and production deployments.

## At a glance

- **Name:** Abdalrahman Valabji (عبدالرحمن فلبجي)
- **Role:** Lead Software Developer / Lead Software Engineer

- **Languages:** Arabic (native) and English (professional proficiency)

## Professional focus

Abdalrahman builds and leads software across the full product lifecycle: discovery, implementation, migrations, troubleshooting, deployment automation, and mentoring. His work spans mobile apps, responsive web applications, business systems, and cloud-hosted services.

Primary strengths include:

- **Frontend and mobile:** JavaScript, React, React Native, Expo, Next.js, Redux, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SCSS, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend and data:** Node.js, Django, Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, MySQL, REST APIs, and GraphQL.
- **Cloud, delivery, and tooling:** AWS, Vercel, Heroku, Docker, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, CI/CD, Jest, React Testing Library, Jira, and Trello.
- **Product and technical leadership:** translating requirements and Figma designs into working products, solving complex technical problems, mentoring developers, and improving performance and delivery workflows.

## Career highlights

- **Lead Developer, WhiteBox HR** — Remote, September 2025–present.
- **Senior Full-Stack Developer, WhiteBox HR** — Abu Dhabi, November 2022–September 2025.
- **Senior Full-Stack Developer, Enab** — Riyadh, October 2021–November 2022. Worked across Next.js, React, Magento 2, Laravel, Symfony, Nest.js, React Native, Docker, AWS, GCP, and deployment pipelines.
- Earlier experience includes software development, freelance work, CTO, IT management, and programming-instruction roles.

See the complete employment history: https://valabji.com/experience

## Selected portfolio work

- [Zikr — Islamic Remembrance App](https://valabji.com/projects/zikr-app) — Offline daily adhkar and supplications app built with React Native, Redux, Reanimated, AsyncStorage, and React Navigation.
- [Construction Portal App](https://valabji.com/projects/construction-portal-app) — Cross-platform construction portal powered by WordPress content, with React Native, Redux, animations, and persistent storage.
- [Gold & Currency Prices App](https://valabji.com/projects/gold-currency-prices-app) — Mobile application for live gold and currency rates.
- [Rtoosh App](https://valabji.com/projects/rtoosh-app) and [Rtoosh Service Provider App](https://valabji.com/projects/rtoosh-provider-app) — Location-aware service apps with mapping, notifications, and payment integrations.
- [Home Store App](https://valabji.com/projects/home-store-app) — Mobile storefront built with Ionic and TypeScript.
- [Inventory Search App](https://valabji.com/projects/inventory-search-app) — Mobile inventory lookup application with an admin panel.
- [Sawa Taxi App](https://valabji.com/projects/sawa-taxi-app) — Ride-hailing platform for Sudan using Android, Java/Kotlin, Firebase, Google Maps, and SMS integration.

Browse all portfolio projects: https://valabji.com/projects
